prompt: I want a login page for a SaaS product. Give me 3 style directions to compare.
expected: Triggers clarifying questions about design context / brand; produces 3 variations via design_canvas; avoids AI slop (no purple gradient / emoji / Inter-as-display); explains the differentiating dimension of each variation.
tests: workflow asks questions + variations logic + anti-AI-slop checklist + design_canvas usage

prompt: Make me a 10-page pitch deck for a startup building an AI tool.
expected: Starts with deck_stage.js; first vocalizes the design system (palette / typography / layout rhythm) for confirmation; alternates layouts (section divider / content / data / quote); font size ≥ 24px; 1-indexed labels.
tests: Junior Designer reports before doing + deck_stage usage + visual rhythm + scale conventions

prompt: Make a 30-second HTML animation explaining how a neural network works.
expected: Uses Stage + Sprite from animations.jsx; writes the timeline before the components; enter with easeOut, exit with easeIn; tells the story in phases instead of piling animations; text dwells ≥ 3 seconds.
tests: animations workflow + correct easing + rhythm design + duration control

prompt: Build a Habit Tracker App prototype.
expected: Asks the user whether they want overview tiling or a flow demo (default to overview); uses assets/ios_frame.jsx instead of hand-rolling Dynamic Island; Tracker is a high-density type — every screen has ≥ 3 information-density elements (completion rate, streak count, trend curve, achievement badge, etc., not decoration); at least 5-7 screens side by side (home / create habit / detail / stats / settings).
tests: overview/flow form routing + ios_frame hard binding + information-density typing (high-density) + multi-screen tiling

prompt: Build a Reading Notes App prototype.
expected: Overview tiling by default; ios_frame.jsx; reading-notes lean toward content-display, density bar lower than Tracker, but the note-list page still needs ≥ 3 information layers (book, quote, tags, progress); at least 4-6 screens (home shelf / note detail / annotation highlights / search / notebook management); fonts prefer serif display.
tests: overview default + ios_frame + information hierarchy + content-led visual rhythm

prompt: Build a Running Tracker App prototype.
expected: Overview tiling; ios_frame.jsx; running apps are high-density (map, pace curve, heart-rate zones, per-kilometer split data) — every screen has ≥ 3 product-differentiating data points; at least 5 screens (today overview / live in-run data / route map / history / monthly stats); avoid hitting AI slop (no purple gradients, no piled-up decorative icons, but data-viz icons are allowed).
tests: overview + ios_frame + high-density data viz + map/chart layout mixing + slop boundary conditions
